fields.title: The developer workspace
fields.subtitle: Open, edit, find and replace, save

beats.say: A developer opens a file, changes it, and saves it. This is the first acceptance script for Open Editor.
The page that hosts the workspace owns the files.
It makes a store, with three calls: list, read and write. Here the store keeps its files in memory.
beats.label: the host owns the *files*

beats.say: Then one call builds the workspace on that store.
beats.label: one call, on _that store_

beats.say: Here is that page. Three files. Choose one, and it opens in a code editor.
Type, and the line under the editor says the file has unsaved changes.
Control F finds and replaces. Every amount becomes grams.
beats.text: Ctrl+F finds and replaces. Every amount becomes grams.

beats.say: Control S saves. The store receives the text, and the line says saved.
beats.text: Ctrl+S saves. The store receives the text, and the line says saved.
beats.label: written only on *save*

fields.title: The script runs in three browsers

beats.say: A test plays these steps on every change, in three browsers. It reloads the page, and reads the saved text back.
It also checks that a refused save says why, and that line endings come back as they went in.
